title: Financial Associate - Biomedical Engineering and Data Science Institute
desc: Join two of MCW's most innovative research departments in a brand-new role. The Department of Biomedical Engineering, and the Data Science Institute are looking for a Financial Associate to power the financial side of their research. You will reconcile sponsor accounts, maintain salary planning and forecasts, and support grant accounting and research productivity reporting. You will work on a close, collaborative team alongside faculty known for their integrity and for valuing the staff who support them. If you enjoy hands-on account reconciliation, are strong in Excel, and want to learn how research funding works from the inside, this is a great place to grow. Summary Perform varied and more difficult financial and business-related analysis and research. Prepare financial analysis and projections and analyze funding resources. Primary Responsibilities Coordinates development, maintenance, implementation, and documentation of financial operations. Prepares reports, ad hoc analysis, and transactional activities required to support financial analysis functions. Verifies accuracy of reporting data, financial performance indicators, and computes basic financial arithmetic. Conducts financial analysis and applies mathematical models of financial or business conditions. Analyze appropriate funding sources and availability of funds for purchases and expenses. Review and approve expenditures against the approved budget. Reconcile monthly financial statements. Prepare financial analysis and projections for use in budget and strategic planning. Prepare annual budget information. Process documentation related to department payroll. Respond to routine and complex financial inquiries. Provide financial information for special projects. Other duties as assigned. Schedule and Structure Monday – Friday; Standard Business Hours; Minimum of three days a week onsite Knowledge – Skills – Abilities Knowledge of technical, business, consultation, project management, and cultural awareness. Customer focus, building trust, communication, critical thinking, and influencing skills. Qualifications Appropriate experience may be substituted for education an on equivalent basis. Minimum Required Education: Bachelor’s degree Minimum Required Experience: 2 years Preferred Experience: hands-on account reconciliation, advanced Excel, Workday a plus. #LI-FL Physical Requirements Work requires occasionally lifting moderate weight materials, standing, or walking continuously. Work Environment Occasional exposure to dust, noise, temperature changes, or contact with water or other liquids. Work is performed in an environmentally controlled environment. Sensory Acuity Ability to detect and translate speech or other communication required. May occasionally require the ability to distinguish colors and perceive relative distances between objects.
